gloss: to roar; to rumble; to resound

definitions.gloss: to roar; to rumble; to thunder
definitions.explanation: To produce a loud, deep, reverberating sound like thunder, explosions, or heavy movement.
To be widely known or celebrated; for fame or reputation to spread.

examples.japanese: {爆発音|ばくはつおん}が{街|まち}にとどろいた。
examples.english: The sound of an explosion thundered through the city.

examples.japanese: {大砲|たいほう}の{音|おと}が{遠|とお}くまでとどろいた。
examples.english: The sound of cannons roared into the distance.

examples.japanese: その{名声|めいせい}は{世界|せかい}にとどろいている。
examples.english: That fame resounds throughout the world.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{名|な}は{業界|ぎょうかい}にとどろいている。
examples.english: His name is renowned in the industry.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}くして{名|な}をとどろかせた{天才|てんさい}ピアニストだ。
examples.english: She is a genius pianist who made her name resound at a young age.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive form とどろかす (to make resound) can be formed causatively.

KANJI:
Can be written as {轟|とどろ}く in formal writing, though hiragana is common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{雷|かみなり}がとどろく (thunder rumbles)
・{地響|じひび}きがとどろく (ground rumbles)
・{拍手|はくしゅ}がとどろく (applause resounds)
・{名|な}をとどろかす (to make one's name resound - become famous)
・{名声|めいせい}がとどろく (fame resounds)

RELATED EXPRESSION:
・{名|な}をとどろかせる (causative) - to make one's name known, to become famous
